reasoning: The icon depicts a simple cartoon face crossed out with a diagonal slash, representing disabling face recognition (Face ID), turning off face retouching/filters, or hiding one's face/identity online. It fits privacy, camera-setting, and anonymization tasks well, though at tiny sizes the internal hair curves and single remaining eye can look slightly cluttered or resemble a crossed-out globe.
